summary: Short kerb at a busy intersection, taxi zone, house 8 m away.
reasons: Busy main road, no parked cars

best_section.where: South kerb of Indooroopilly Road west of the Five Ways bus stop

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 8 m at the start, apartments 14 m at the end; shopping centre car park opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb beside a multi-lane road with no parked cars on this side.
drivers.traffic: Heavy: signalised junction, buses and a bus stop beside the end.
drivers.convention: Taxi Zone signs; nobody parks overnight on this kerb.

sun_shade: Mostly shaded by trees on the south side; open to the north.
